transcript.line: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.

📺 Antonina killed Rut King out past the ridge — alone — and walked home. 4 rounds, 34 taken. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Antonina telling Omar about herself. The retelling is already better than the event.

🔥 The fire settles. Antonina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Rut King — I put it down today." "He lowers the crown. Paws the earth once, twice. The whole forest holds its breath." "His chest swells. The inhale goes on too long — cover your ears or get behind something." A b
Antonina hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
📋 Antonina — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 Antonina gathers deadfall — 1 stick + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (8 sticks now.)
Antonina stared at their hands for a long time today. Something is changing.
Antonina is back at the fires, and the village doesn't need convincing this time. Milagros answers for what happened to Antonina — again.
Antonina calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.

👀 When the others traded stories about Denver, Antonina went quiet in a way that wasn't listening — more like realizing they had nothing true to trade.
🔥 Naran says it at the fire, not quite looking at Antonina: “Your past story doesn’t add up. Someone had to say it.” The fire goes quiet in the way it does when someone’s decided to be brave.

“You’re right.” Antonina doesn’t look up. “I wasn’t Denver. I was Arkhangelsk, Russia. I’m sorry — I wanted a cleaner story than I had.” The fire lets it land. Someone passes Antonina the bowl without a word.
You catch fragments by the fire — Adaeze telling Antonina about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
